name: gramax
title_zh: Markdown 写文档，Git 管版本
tagline_zh: 受够了文档散落在多人协作文档里、版本混乱？把文档当代码管：本地写 Markdown，Git 提交即发布。
tagline_en: Tired of docs scattered across drives with no versioning? Treat docs as code: write Markdown, commit to Git.
desc_en: Embrace a docs-as-code approach to build, version, and publish Git-driven documentation sites using Markdown and a visual editor
why_zh: 它把文档工作流对齐代码工作流：分支、PR、回滚、审阅全复用 Git 基建。
why_en: It aligns docs with code workflows—branches, PRs, rollbacks, reviews—while a visual editor lowers the contribution bar, syncing.
limit_zh: 需要团队已有 Git 工作流基础；可视化编辑器主要面向 Markdown 结构，复杂排版（如多栏。
limit_en: Requires existing Git workflow; visual editor handles Markdown structure, not complex layouts (multi-column, custom components) which need code; no.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
